CompanionStore.reason: Reviewed concrete production owners: LiveService/PreviewService, LocalDrafts/LocalFinished, value state and Sendable task/clock handles. Those implementations are UI-free; new Store constructor sites require review. Helper receipt notice and consumed IDs add only String/Set values. Approval warning owns only String/Date value fields. Sleep request/refresh sets contain only CompanionTarget string-value identifiers; no callbacks, UI owners or deinit side effects. Guided Sleep command IDs are String values. Provider flows preserve their own MainActor teardown for injected service/callback owners. Runtime invokes Store.shutdown inside its real MainActor task before any await, clearing providerFlows so a SwiftUI-retained Store can later die outside a task without owning isolated-deinit flows. Store's empty deinit does no cleanup itself. Full-event review records add only String/UUID values and immutable Sendable event/reference structs backed by AnnexJSON; failure maps contain Strings. These own no UI objects, callbacks or teardown effects. Wrong-machine refusals (#339) add only a CompanionTarget-keyed map of Sendable value structs (Strings and an optional CompanionTarget); no callbacks, UI ownership or teardown work. Grant requests (#337) add only slot-keyed String sets/maps, an optional String notice, and (answer enum, String command id) tuples; no callbacks, UI ownership or teardown work. Dispatcher settings (#338) add only an optional CompanionDispatcherResetPrompt (Sendable value struct of Strings and an enum), a Set<String> of host ids and a String-keyed map of String notices; no callbacks, UI ownership or teardown work.

CompanionRuntime.reason: Root release reproduces the isolated-deinit runtime abort (#349). The MainActor task retains FeedbackModel, CompanionTelemetry, CompanionFeedbackPresenter and the WHOLE Store subtree. Its first statement quiesces Presenter observers, offers and pending status work; before any await, Store.shutdown stops listening and clears isolated-deinit providerFlows, and telemetry stops. This protects both a Store retained beyond Runtime teardown and a Presenter retained while transport disconnect waits. Store's other reference holders (TimelineProjection, ReadingBookmark/Viewport, TranscriptExpansion/PartExpansion and ImageBytes) are reviewed ARC-only; remaining state is values and Sendable handles. The task then waits for pending lifecycle transitions and shuts down LiveService to cancel/disconnect transport retry loops and relinquish its registrations even if SwiftUI retains Store. All retained owners are released inside a real Swift task. Remaining Runtime fields are reviewed preferences, Sendable actors and values. Fields and exact deinit body are gated.

CompanionLiveService.reason: Transport/value/task state; all five production callbacks in AppRoot capture Runtime WEAKLY, not raw UI. New assignments require capture review. MCP-off cache adds only a Sendable value struct containing Bool, optional String and Set<String>; no callback or UI ownership. Network snapshot/refusal callbacks capture Runtime weakly; arguments are Sendable membership values and String identifiers. They own no UIKit objects and add no teardown work. Registration transport identities add only a String-to-UUID dictionary, with no callbacks, UI ownership or teardown work. Full-event review records add only String/UUID values and immutable Sendable event/reference structs backed by AnnexJSON; failure maps contain Strings. These own no UI objects, callbacks or teardown effects. Saved commands are keyed by CompanionCommandKey (#339), a Hashable value of two Strings; values remain Sendable AnnexCommand structs. Grant requests (#337) add only a host-keyed map of String id sets; no callbacks, UI ownership or teardown work.

CompanionProviderFlow.reason: Owns an injected CompanionService protocol and canRequest callback. Remaining fields are provider receipt/target/String/Bool values, with no cleanup side effects.

CompanionRecoveryFixtureService.reason: DEBUG-only concrete synthetic service. It stores no user callback, UIView, controller, UIImage, transport or arbitrary protocol owner. beginTeardown closes all future holds before resuming pending requests on MainActor; deinit performs no resumption, cancellation or UI work. All service responses are value CompanionHistory or fixed String errors.

CompanionRecoveryFixtureScene.reason: DEBUG-only scene owns the reviewed concrete RecoveryFixtureService, reviewed UI-free CompanionStore constructed with that service, and Bool/Bool?/Int/CompanionTarget values. The initial-details seed and passive observed-seed/update-count witnesses add only values, with no callback, UI owner or task storage. Constructor captures no UI object or callback. UIKit hosting/window objects belong only to test method locals; this owner has no teardown work.
